name: Emerald Isle
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in Emerald Isle?
answer_short: Yes, with town rules. Emerald Isle keeps golf carts off NC 58 (Emerald Drive) and Coast Guard Road except to cross. Atlantic Beach allows registered carts on streets posted 35 mph or less, but not Fort Macon Road or the causeway. LSVs may use roads posted 35 mph or less in Emerald Isle.

golf_cart.roads: Town streets, not NC 58, Coast Guard Rd or Fort Macon Rd

rules.rule: Golf carts on all town streets except NC 58 (Emerald Dr) and Coast Guard Rd; cross straight over only
Registered, inspected carts on streets posted 35 mph or less; not NC 58/Fort Macon Rd or the causeway
Registered, insured LSVs on roads posted 35 mph or less; may cross faster roads at intersections

banned_roads.name: NC 58 (Emerald Drive)
banned_roads.rule: No golf carts; cross straight over

banned_roads.name: Coast Guard Road
banned_roads.rule: No golf carts; cross straight over

banned_roads.name: Fort Macon Road / Atlantic Beach Causeway
banned_roads.rule: No golf carts in Atlantic Beach

faq.q: Where can I drive my LSV in Emerald Isle?
faq.a: Roads posted 35 mph or less. Registered and insured. A town or county can still ban LSVs from a specific road, and posted signs win.

faq.q: Can I drive a golf cart on Emerald Drive?
faq.a: No. Golf carts may only cross NC 58 (Emerald Drive) straight over, never drive along it.

faq.q: Can I use the bike path in a golf cart in Emerald Isle?
faq.a: No. The town's rules keep golf carts off the bike path and sidewalks.
